originalHomeFaq.q: What is executive health and performance coaching?
originalHomeFaq.a: Coaching helps founders and executives build a practical plan for strength, aerobic fitness, sleep and recovery. Marin adapts the plan to your workload, training history and progress. It does not replace medical care.

originalHomeFaq.q: How much does coaching with Marin Lazic cost?
originalHomeFaq.a: 1:1 executive performance coaching is $2,400 AUD per month with a minimum commitment of 3 months. The training plan, recovery work and communication are agreed before you start. The online Performance Assessment is free.
Founders, executives and professionals who want a training and recovery plan that fits a demanding schedule. Your goals, health context and available time are considered before coaching starts.
Yes. Individual coaching is delivered online, with training programmes in Bridge Athletic and remote communication. Marin is based in Sydney, Australia.

Marin is the Strength and Conditioning Coach for the Australian Men's Water Polo Team. His work includes preparation for Paris 2024 and the LA28 pathway. He is also the founder of Otion, a health and performance company.

originalHomeFaq.q: How do I apply for coaching?
originalHomeFaq.a: Complete the short application at the Apply page. Marin reviews it personally and follows up by email. A sales call is not required. Availability and the coaching plan are confirmed before you commit.

originalHomeFaq.q: What does the free performance assessment include?
originalHomeFaq.a: The online questionnaire covers your goals, sleep, stress, training, injuries, nutrition and recovery. It produces a coaching score, a category breakdown and an AI-assisted report. The score is based on your answers, not a clinical diagnosis.
Marin Lazic is the Strength and Conditioning Coach for the Australian Men's Water Polo Team and the founder of Otion. He coaches founders and executives from Sydney, Australia.
Otion is Marin Lazic's health and performance company, founded in 2023. It delivers coaching programs to founders, executives and organisations.

originalApplyFaq.a: 1:1 coaching costs $2,400 AUD per month, with a minimum commitment of 3 months. Submitting the application does not charge you or enrol you in coaching.
Marin reads the application and follows up by email. You can discuss your goals, the coaching plan and availability before deciding whether to start.

originalApplyFaq.q: Do I need to book a sales call?
originalApplyFaq.a: No. The application and initial follow-up can be handled by email.

originalApplyFaq.q: Can coaching diagnose a health problem?
originalApplyFaq.a: No. Coaching covers training and health behaviours. Persistent fatigue, pain, sleep problems or mental health concerns may need assessment by a qualified healthcare professional.
